content.text:
Three changes, clean compile. Here's what was done:

---

**Refactoring 10 — Extract `DefaultExcerptGenerator` + fix `setRawType` bug** (3 files)

**`DefaultExcerptGenerator` extraction** (`PostReconciler.java`, `SinglePageReconciler.java`, new `DefaultExcerptGenerator.java`)

The identical 7-line `static class DefaultExcerptGenerator implements ExcerptGenerator` inner class was present verbatim in both reconcilers. It is now a package-level class in `run.halo.app.core.reconciler` — the same package as both reconcilers, so no import is needed in either. Both `new DefaultExcerptGenerator()` call sites resolve to the shared class unchanged.

**`setRawType` bug fix** (`SinglePageReconciler.java:394`)

The `getExcerpt` context builder in `SinglePageReconciler` had two consecutive `.setRaw(...)` calls:
```java
.setRaw(content.getRaw())
.setContent(content.getContent())
.setRaw(content.getRawType())   // ← overwrites raw with the type string
```
The third call should have been `.setRawType(content.getRawType())`. This was silently overwriting the page's raw content with the raw type identifier (e.g., `"markdown"`), causing excerpt generation to receive wrong data. Fixed to `.setRawType(content.getRawType())`.
